So, we're all internet users. Chances are you've been using the Internet for a while. We've all seen sarcastic jokes and comments, only to have people take those jokes and comments seriously. Now, a couple years ago, it became common practice to mark sarcasm with /s. And it works great. But, I feel it detracts from the joke if that /s is just hanging there, making it obvious. People have always said that there should be a sarcasm font.

The great thing is, someone has already made a sarcastic font. It's basically italics, but turned around. The reason this style has had a hard time spreading is that few sites have implemented it. I honestly don't know the amount of effort it would take to implement a sarcastic font, so maybe someone can mention if it's as easy as adding a new format to rewriting the fundamental code of the internet.

If it is easy to implement, however, I think it would be a step forward in the evolution of the Internet. BOLD HAS ALWAYS BEEN ABOUT HIGHLIGHTING THE POINT while Italics has always been about subtly emphasizing a certain part of a statement. I feel that, in honor of the old /s tag, maybe it could be:

/s/ This is a sarcastic joke /s/

I want to at least see how you guys would feel about a sarcastic font.

Hello everyone of WhoaVerse!

Now that Planate is finished, it's time to move on to a new theme! One of my favorite website styles of the Internet is typography. Typography is the art of putting words and letters together to make something beautiful. The theme will fit well in the more text-heavy subverses or subverses with a text-based theme, like a newspaper subverse.

Typography is a hard style to do right and that's why I chose the challenge. I also chose it because I am terrible at graphics art — other than pixel art.

There's another purpose to this post: I need to post links to style them, haha. I'm not about to post random, derp posts to fill the feed up because this subverse is also supposed to be a discussion of the theme.

The theme is partially done. The header and sidebar are mostly done. I'm working on the links and comments now. I will release the theme for testing when I get a working version done. Until then, if you'd like to keep up-to-date with this theme, subscribe!
